descriptions.interaction: The authored FIN-organization example contrasts traditional successive filtering with visual narrowing/counting along the proposed time-oriented representation. The new method specifies a visual encoding and inferencing procedure; functioning filter widgets or an implemented interactive tool are not established.
descriptions.guidance: The proposed inference variable captures the analysis goal (e.g. time or location). Aligning subject/object lifespans and relationship arcs with that variable provides task-context salience for visual inferencing. More general zoning, prioritizing and categorical drill-down are discussed as possible design directions, not demonstrated functions.
